# StratumCore

> StratumCore is an independent finance advisory firm based in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. It provides cost reduction diagnostics, financial control and governance, and finance team development to mid-tier mining operators, mining contractors and other asset-intensive businesses across Queensland, the Northern Territory and Australia.

StratumCore is a trading name of StratumCore Pty Ltd (ABN 61 696 477 406). The firm is principal-led: engagements are delivered by senior practitioners with mining operating experience, not junior staff.

## Services

- Cost reduction: a six-week fixed-fee cost diagnostic for mining operations, producing benchmarked unit cost analysis, prioritised initiatives ranked by value and effort, and a board-ready savings case. https://www.stratumcore.com.au/cost-reduction/
- Financial control and governance: spend control and procurement discipline, financial visibility and reporting, policies and delegations, planning and forecasting, and finance function design for businesses that have scaled fast, typically mining and civil contractors and mining services businesses in the $20M to $200M revenue range. https://www.stratumcore.com.au/financial-control-governance/
- Corporate advisory overview. https://www.stratumcore.com.au/corporate-advisory/
- Finance team building: leadership development coaching and workshops for finance leaders. https://www.stratumcore.com.au/finance-team-building/ and https://www.stratumcore.com.au/leadership-development/
- Finance Business Partner Academy: a five-module programme (Financial Storytelling, Influencing Without Authority, Value Driver Trees, Diagnostic Problem Solving, Planning and Execution) using case-method teaching. https://www.stratumcore.com.au/finance-business-partner-academy/

## People

- Wen Khong, Principal. Chartered Accountant (CA ANZ), Chartered Secretary (Governance Institute of Australia), Harvard Business School alumnus. Prior senior finance roles at BHP, Wesfarmers, BUMA Australia and Ernst & Young. https://www.stratumcore.com.au/about/
- Calvin Yong, principal consultant on selected engagements. CPA, MBA (University of Queensland). Prior roles at BMA, BHP, Bankwest and CS Gas.

## Sectors and regions

Open-cut coal and metalliferous mining, mining contractors, mining services, energy and infrastructure. Queensland (Bowen Basin, Surat Basin, North West Queensland), Northern Territory, and other Australian states by arrangement. Office in Brisbane.
